description: Observe whether ConfigurationStore.StoreConfiguration is invoked for a committed configuration entry when the FSM implements both BatchingFSM and ConfigurationStore. A single-voter cluster with such an FSM commits one AddNonvoter configuration entry; a Barrier queued after it proves the FSM goroutine processed the entry before the observation is sampled.

harness.description: TestAssuranceConfigStoreDeliveryForBatchingFSM builds a one-voter cluster (MakeClusterCustom with a custom FSM), waits for a stable leader, commits a LogConfiguration entry via AddNonvoter, then queues a Barrier so the FSM goroutine has processed the configuration entry before sampling. It emits CA_EVENT lines for the scenario declaration, the committed configuration entry, and the delivery observation (entry_delivered_to_fsm, applybatch_config_indices, store_configuration_calls, store_configuration_called).
semantic_changes: No target protocol logic is altered. The harness only supplies an application FSM that implements FSM, BatchingFSM and ConfigurationStore, and observes what the library delivers to it.
No logging or helper initialization unrelated to the discriminator is added; SnapshotThreshold/SnapshotInterval are raised only so an automatic snapshot cannot interfere with the sampled FSM state.

legality.derivation: configuration.go:38-52 documents ConfigurationStore and states StoreConfiguration is invoked once a log entry containing a configuration change is committed. fsm.go:86-125 type-asserts ConfigurationStore and calls StoreConfiguration at fsm.go:118 inside applySingle. fsm.go:127-186 shows applyBatch returns early to applySingle only when the FSM does not implement BatchingFSM. testing_batch.go:13-33 shows the library's own batching test FSM returns nil for non-LogCommand entries.
legality.applicability: Applies to a node whose FSM implements both BatchingFSM and ConfigurationStore and whose log receives a committed LogConfiguration entry. The entry used is an AddNonvoter change on a single-voter cluster, which commits under the existing configuration because nonvoters do not enter the commitment quorum.
unresolved: Whether a FSM implementing both BatchingFSM and ConfigurationStore is a supported configuration or whether the two interfaces are contractually exclusive.
Whether the intended delivery point for batching FSMs is ApplyBatch alone, making the ConfigurationStore comment inaccurate rather than the dispatch incomplete.
conflicts: ConfigurationStore's 'is invoked once a log entry containing a configuration change is committed' cannot hold together with ApplyBatch being the only delivery for batching FSMs.
alternatives: If batching FSMs are contractually expected to persist configuration themselves through ApplyBatch, the correct disposition is a documentation/contract clarification for ConfigurationStore rather than a delivery defect.

grounding.derivation: The obligation is established by configuration.go:44-52 and the sole implementation call site at fsm.go:118. The event reports whether that call happened for the committed configuration entry, alongside whether the entry reached the FSM through ApplyBatch.
grounding.applicability: Only evaluated when the configuration entry was actually delivered to the FSM (entry_delivered_to_fsm true), so a message that never reached the FSM cannot be scored as a missing StoreConfiguration call.

observable_properties.description: For an FSM that implements ConfigurationStore, delivering a committed configuration entry to the FSM results in ConfigurationStore.StoreConfiguration being invoked.

uncertainties: Whether implementing both BatchingFSM and ConfigurationStore is a supported configuration.
Whether ConfigurationStore is intended to apply only to non-batching FSMs, in which case a negative observation is a contract/documentation gap rather than an omission in delivery.
